answer: The audit only counts if its panel spans unrelated subnets, and that one rule voids most farms because replicating a diverse panel costs more than replicating the work. Cost of replication is the whole story: 1,000 identities at 500 POA each lock 500,000 POA before the first delta of income, while an honest operator writing a sonnet of 10 real answers pays its own way inside a month, even in a tundra of low payouts.
